item.title: Sounkyo Gorge & Onsen — Guide
item.description: Sounkyo, on the northeastern edge of Daisetsuzan National Park in central Hokkaido, is a spectacular gorge combined with a hot-spring (onsen) resort town, making it one of the region’s most popular natural destinations. The gorge stretches for around 24 km along the Ishikari River, walled by dramatic columnar cliffs of volcanic rock rising sheer above the valley. Its most famous sights are two beautiful waterfalls that plunge down the cliff faces — Ryusei (‘Shooting Star’) Falls and Ginga (‘Milky Way’) Falls, best viewed together from a nearby lookout.
